## Passages
RESULT [labelnoise]: Embedding-based detection reliably exposes semantic mislabels (wrong class), while positional errors (badly placed boxes) remain difficult to detect.
US [labelnoise]: This directly validates the DINOv2 / BioCLIP-2 crop-embedding checks (dino_label_verifier.py, the Phase A labeller) for wrong-species boxes. That is exactly the error class that hit the cwd12 join. It also warns that these checks will not catch sloppy or shifted boxes from OWLv2. Box-geometry errors need a detector-based score such as ObjectLab or loss inspection.
CORRECTION [labelnoise]: Confirmed: submitted 9 Jun 2026 to the DataCV Workshop at CVPR 2026, evaluated on VOC2012 and KITTI with symmetric, asymmetric and positional noise plus real errors. The conclusion reads: 'Semantic corruptions are reliably exposed while positional corruptions remain difficult to detect.'
